# Percona Operator for MongoDB

> Percona Operator for MongoDB deploys and manages Percona Server for MongoDB replica sets and sharded clusters on Kubernetes, with backups, scaling, upgrades and monitoring.

Each page below is also available as markdown. For the documentation of all Percona products, see https://docs.percona.com/llms.txt.

- [Welcome](https://docs.percona.com/percona-operator-for-mongodb/1.23.1/index.md)
